description: This file implements a JUnit XML reporter for the Ginkgo testing framework, including functions for generating, merging, and cleaning up JUnit reports, as well as defining report data structures and configuration options.

classes.name: JUnitReportConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for the JUnit report generation, including flags to omit certain information based on test states or labels.

classes.name: JUnitTestSuites
classes.description: Represents the entire set of test suites in a JUnit report, including aggregate statistics and individual test suite entries.

classes.name: JUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Represents a single test suite within the JUnit report, including metadata, statistics, properties, and test cases.

classes.name: JUnitProperties
classes.description: A collection of key-value properties associated with a test suite.

classes.name: JUnitTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, including its status, timing, owner, and output.

classes.name: JUnitSkipped
classes.description: Details about a skipped or pending test case.

classes.name: JUnitError
classes.description: Details about an errored or interrupted test case.

classes.name: JUnitFailure
classes.description: Details about a failed test case.

classes.name: JUnitReporter
classes.description: A deprecated struct for creating JUnit reports, included for backward compatibility.

methods.name: GenerateJUnitReport
methods.description: Generates a JUnit report from a test report and writes it to a specified destination.

methods.name: GenerateJUnitReportWithConfig
methods.description: Generates a JUnit report with custom configuration options.

methods.name: MergeAndCleanupJUnitReports
methods.description: Merges multiple JUnit report files into a single report and cleans up the source files.

methods.name: failureDescriptionForUnstructuredReporters
methods.description: Creates a detailed failure description string for a test spec.

methods.name: systemErrForUnstructuredReporters
methods.description: Returns the timeline-based system error output for a test spec.

methods.name: RenderTimeline
methods.description: Renders the timeline of a test spec as a string.

methods.name: systemOutForUnstructuredReporters
methods.description: Returns the captured stdout/stderr output for a test spec.

methods.name: formatComponentSemVerConstraintsToString
methods.description: Converts component semantic version constraints map to a string.

methods.name: NewJUnitReporter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the deprecated JUnitReporter.
